raw:
@s1 stated
  relation "pass the exam"
  role subject "most of students from the Debrecen group"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted

@q query
  mode count
  select ?x
  where all
    match
      relation "be from"
      role subject ?x
      role object "the Debrecen group"
      polarity affirmed
    end
    match
      relation "have points"
      role subject ?x
      role object ?score
      polarity affirmed
    end
  end
  compare ?score above 80
